title: Tasty, wonderful walking tour!
text: We enjoyed this tour with the guide, Orkhan. The tour was a very small group (ended up being 4 people) which my husband and I liked a lot, as it seemed more personalized. We started at a yummy local coffee shop then started our tour. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and we learned a lot! From architecture to Michelin star ratings to typical que times for the local desert eateries. We laughed and laughed, as the tour guide is very funny, sharing stories and so on. I believe the idea of the tour, when you read coffee in the title,  is not simply to go to coffee shops exclusively and sitting
author: Britni_W

title: We had a very...
text: We went for a very nice walk and learned a few things about the city. It was a nice introduction to the city with some helpful tips.😊
author: Marko_R

title: A pretty walk...
text: A pretty nice tour of the city of Barcelona! They will pass through several cultural sites and incredible streets. The guide is amazing and always willing to educate us about the architecture of the beautiful buildings, as well as the best places to try the best food or simply relax and have a glass.
author: Samuel_A

title: Have a local show you their favorite spots
text: Casual exploration of Barcelona streets around the El Born area - this is exactly what we wanted, to have a local show us around the area in a very small group and describe everything from the rents to the political climate, depending on what questions you ask. Note Orkhan doesn’t physically take you into a bunch of coffee shops - you start with a coffee and start walking, and you are pretty much free to stop and say you want to grab something along the way. This is great if you’ve been doing a bunch of large group guided tours and want a less structured view of the city with recommendations.
author: Laura_R

title: Friendly guide
text: It was so pleasant time. We had a very nice tour with Orkhan, was not so much heavy info, we saw main things, had coffee, brunch and stayed a good friends with him. If you are looking for historical guide it may be not for you but main things he will tell you!
author: Agne_S

title: Orkhan was an incredible...
text: Orkhan was an incredible guide! I went on the tour with only him and my friend and we were immediately greeted with open arms. The tour was filled with endless stories, history, and laughing. I highly recommend this activity!!
author: Danielle_O

title: I would so it again
text: Very lovely experience. Orxan was friendly and fun. He showed me around and even offered to take pictures of me as I am traveling alone. This tour was totally worth it. I recommand it without hesitation.
author: Yoann_C

title: Orkhan gave us a private...
text: Orkhan gave us a private tour, and he really knew his stuff! Not only did he take us for coffee and sweets, but we also learned all about different neighborhoods in the city and got to see a unique perspective featuring local artisan shops, history, and ended with a fun lunch. Definitely a good time, but bring your walking shoes!
author: Melissa_M
